title: ID0447429-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001321] no terminal connected
description:
Reported issue:
no terminal connected
Solution: replace Terminal
yyyy-mm-dd: NA
Note to Warranty manager - previous ticket ID0444657 was closed due to no availability to troubleshoot on-site and as such from service side it was closed. The charger was under warranty at that time (which ended at 2/Sep/2025), new ticket was created for FS team to work on it.
Customer:
On the MA-197-02, CCV still did not work after rebooting. The charger cannot connect to the terminal (“no terminal connected”). I was also unable to connect to the terminal using the TS3 software.
The terminal produces a pulsating beep (as we also had in Aalst with the defective terminal there)
